review.text: Loved this place so much. Perfect for family and friends outings. Property is so huge. I learned so much about farming and they have so many activities. I didn’t got bore for a second. Staff is very helpful and food is top notch. Will visit again for sure.

Pros: Location is great. Out of the hustle of the town. Greenery all around and waterfront rooms. Food is good, local culinary included in the package, non veg is served.
Lunch, snack, dinner and breakfast.
Glass house is more than apt for 4 pax.
Room was clean.
Free activites like cycling and archery was entertaining

Cons: Activities can be much better. Upkeep of board games and cycles is due. Swimming pool facility is basic no active filtration.
Kayaking is there but could have skipped the Rs 100 for 30 mins. Couldn't enjoy cz of the rains. Approach road needs leveling and gravel.

Great for large groups.

A perfect getaway surrounded by breathtaking landscapes, lush greenery, and serene natural beauty! The expansive property offers a refreshing escape, where every corner showcases picturesque views and tranquil surroundings.
The resort offers an exciting range of activities, including toy train rides, kayaking, cycling, archery, rifle shooting, badminton, cricket, bird games, a sparkling swimming pool, and an energetic rain dance area. Both children and adults can enjoy endless recreation and adventure.
The best time to visit is from November to February for pleasant weather, while the monsoon season transforms the property into a magical green paradise with misty views and refreshing rainfall.
The food is absolutely delicious and plentiful. The breakfast spread includes flavorful poha, spicy misal, freshly baked brun pav, and other local delicacies. High tea is equally delightful, featuring crispy batata vadas, hot bhajiyas, and tasty chaat.
Lunch and dinner offer an impressive variety, including two vegetarian dishes, two chicken preparations, dal-rice, aromatic pulao, Chinese dishes, refreshing chaas, authentic solkadi, kheer, gulab jamun, pastries, and many other mouthwatering options. The menu changes daily, making each meal a pleasant surprise.
The stunning views, scenic landscapes, peaceful atmosphere, and abundant natural beauty make this destination truly memorable. It is an ideal place for families, friends, and nature lovers seeking relaxation, adventure, and excellent hospitality.

A Perfect Family Getaway at Sanjivani Farms, Saphale!
Had an amazing experience at Sanjivani Farms! The property is beautifully maintained and surrounded by lush greenery, making it the perfect escape from the city hustle. The toy train ride was a unique attraction and loved by everyone in our group.
There were plenty of fun activities for all age groups, from cycling and kayaking to relaxing in the hammock garden. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and offered a peaceful stay amidst nature.
The staff was extremely courteous and always ready to help. The food was fresh, delicious, and served with great hospitality. Every corner of the property is thoughtfully designed to provide both relaxation and entertainment.
Highly recommended for families, couples, and anyone looking for a refreshing nature retreat near Mumbai. Can't wait to visit again! 🌿🚂✨
Had an amazing time at Sanjivani Farm! 🥹💚 Beautiful property, delicious food, fun activities and such peaceful vibes. Perfect place for a little getaway! Definitely loved the experience ✨
